title: Cola Slush Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Cola Slush Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
Flavor
Unleash a wave of nostalgia with the Cola Slush Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Every inhale delivers the crisp, sweet fizz of your favorite cola drink, perfectly blended with a frosty slush for an icy finish. The well-balanced flavor profile is crafted to indulge your taste buds and keep cravings satisfied all day long.
Disposable Design
No refills, no charging, no hassle. The Cola Slush Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is a disposable vape designed for ultimate simplicity. With an impressive puff count of up to 25,000, this device ensures long-lasting enjoyment without the need to carry extra equipment or accessories. Perfect for on-the-go lifestyles.
Sleek, Compact, and Stylish
Slip it into your pocket or bag and take it anywhere. The slim and portable design of the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is as fashionable as it is functional. Whether you’re at home, on a night out, or traveling, it’s your trusty companion for a smooth vaping experience.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow
:
Adjustable for customized draw
Take Your Flavor Game to the Next Level
Get ready to elevate your vaping experience. The Cola Slush Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 isn’t just a vape; it’s your ticket to bold flavor, convenience, and style in every puff. Why settle for ordinary when you can enjoy extraordinary?
